Ivy (CS): Quick alert: NimbusHub onboarding showing rising p95 on 'reply_short' and CFO flagged unit cost. proposing a small perf experiment.
Arjun (ML Eng): Quick numbers?
Ivy (CS): p50 ~60ms, p95 ~430ms during peak. token cost +19% MoM. workload: lots of short replies (avg ~8 tokens) and repeated system prefix.
Lina (AE): Renewal in 9 weeks. finance will want clear upside and rollback plan.
Cam (SRE): Any stability issues?
Ivy (CS): No errors. just latency and cost.
Arjun (ML Eng): Low-risk plan: prefix/KV caching + weighted routing to compact-2b-int8 for non-sensitive traffic. Keep 90/10 canary, guard legal/finance tags to current model.
Lina (AE): If we can show ~25% cost down and minimal quality impact, that's a renewal win.
Arjun (ML Eng): I'll run a 72h canary and an eval on 400 samples. metric gates: rollback if p95 > 700ms or quality drop > 3%.
Cam (SRE): I'll add the routing policy + cache config in Console and set auto-rollback hooks. deploy-bot will post events.
deploy-bot: Canary started for nimbushub/reply_short (90/10). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/teams/nimbushub/deploys/2951234567
Ivy (CS): Action items: @Arjun run canary & post eval, @Cam set alerts and rollback, @Lina prepare renewal note. I'll collect in-app quick feedback after 24h.
Arjun (ML Eng): 18h update: canary shows cost_per_1k_tokens -27%, p95 for canary -110ms, eval accept_rate delta +0.5%. uploading CSV to shared drive.
Ivy (CS): Awesome. If stable, promote to 40% for non-tagged traffic after 72h. scheduling enablement with NimbusHub ops. Thanks team :raised_hands:
